==Description==
'''Campfire''' is an interactable [[Emotes|emote]] that was obtained upon redeeming the [[Krampus' Revenge Event#Gifts|Gift of Warmth]], achieved by dealing 300,000 damage to [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] using the [[Pyromancer]] or its [[Golden Pyromancer|golden variant]]. It was created by CapraKinetics. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote, though sound effects can be heard while eating marshmallows. You cannot move while performing this emote.

When using the emote, a campfire will spawn next to the player with a marshmallow roasting over it. The marshmallow will get darker with time, until it turns completely black and catches on fire. The player can press the left mouse button to eat the marshmallow. There does not appear to be any way to perform this emote on mobile.
